name: getAppearance
description: Read the appearance state the React Settings pages still need. The PRIMARY field is `locale` — the prospective UI locale (kApplicationLocale in LOCAL STATE, the same pref chrome://settings/languages writes; outside ChromeOS nothing registers it on a profile, so reading it there is a CHECK failure inside PrefService — Chrome's own languages_handler.cc uses the profile only under IS_CHROMEOS). The three LEGACY colour fields — `scheme`, `variant`, `color` — are kept OPTIONAL for ONE release so the desktop panel's one-shot migration can read the profile's previous ThemeService values; they are absent when the profile has no value to migrate (a fresh profile), and new clients must resolve colours through appearance.resolveTheme instead. Named getAppearance rather than get because generated input structs share one namespace and system_prefs already owns GetInput.
